findings.title: The selected provider cannot perform general crypto operations
findings.body: This provider is registered with ServiceLoader and `AuthzClient.create()` initializes `CryptoIntegration`, so it can become the process-wide provider when the authz-client is used without another provider. `getSignature()` (and most other crypto methods in this class) throws `UnsupportedOperationException`; consequently, code that uses Keycloak crypto APIs through `CryptoIntegration`, including client authentication that needs a signature, fails at runtime after creating an `AuthzClient`.

findings.title: The Bouncy Castle accessor returns an unrelated provider
findings.body: `getBouncyCastleProvider()` promises a Bouncy Castle provider, but this returns the provider backing the JVM's default keystore type (commonly SUN). Callers using this accessor to obtain Bouncy Castle services will receive the wrong provider and may fail to find the expected algorithms.

findings.title: Adding an abstract method breaks existing CryptoProvider implementations
findings.body: `CryptoProvider` is a public extension interface, and adding abstract `order()` makes existing third-party implementations fail to compile until updated; already-compiled implementations can also fail when provider discovery invokes the method. Make this a default method with a documented fallback order to preserve compatibility.
